sentence: No peap lands on a peanius still clutching yesterday's ceiling.

wombos.definition: A person who operates at the intersection of peak performance and genius-level intellect — someone both exceptionally intelligent and impressively capable.
wombos.example: Everyone in the room knew they were dealing with a certified peanius.

wombos.definition: A peak pep talk — an exceptionally powerful or uplifting form of encouragement that brings someone to their best self.
wombos.example: He wasn't feeling it, so I gave him a peap talk before the big moment.
